title: Kayaker clinging to a moored yacht
summary: A kayaker capsized on the ebb and held on to a mooring buoy chain until the crew arrived.
body:
Paged at 14:12 by county dispatch after a walker on the marina wall called 911.

The inshore lifeboat was on scene at 14:21. The kayaker was cold but talking, and was lifted aboard and taken to the slipway, where an ambulance crew took over. The kayak was recovered on the next tide.

title: Search for an overdue walker on the saltmarsh
summary: A walker overdue on the marsh path was found safe on the sea wall after dark.
body:
Paged at 17:40 with the tide flooding. Shore crew searched the sea wall with the response vehicle while the boat worked the creeks with its searchlight.

The walker had taken shelter at the old pump house and was walked back to the car park by shore crew.

title: Dog swept over Hather Weir
outcome: Dog recovered; owner stayed on the bank
summary: A spaniel went over the weir after a stick. The owner rang 911 instead of going in.
body: The dog was found on the gravel bar below the weir, tired but unhurt. The crew want to thank the owner, who did exactly what our dog advice asks: stay out of the water and call.

title: Yacht aground on the Bar on a falling tide
outcome: Crew of three taken off; yacht refloated next tide
summary: A visiting yacht missed the channel buoys and grounded on the north edge of the Bar.
body: With the tide falling, the yacht's crew of three were taken off and landed at the marina. The lifeboat returned on the night flood and towed the yacht clear at 01:20.

title: Swimmer in difficulty below the town bridge
outcome: Recovered by a bystander with a throw line
summary: A teenager swimming below the bridge was carried downstream by the current.
body: A passer-by used the throw line from the bridge safety station, installed by the lifejacket and throw line appeal. The crew arrived to find the swimmer already on the bank and checked him over with EMS.

title: Paddleboarders cut off by the tide
summary: Two paddleboarders were cut off on a mud island when the tide turned.
body: Both were wearing leashes and buoyancy aids and had a phone in a pouch, which made this a short job. They were brought back to the slipway with their boards.

title: Medical callout at the marina pontoons
summary: A boat owner collapsed on a pontoon where the ambulance could not reach.
body: Shore crew carried the casualty up the pontoon on the rescue stretcher to the waiting ambulance.

title: Motor cruiser with engine failure in the channel
summary: A cruiser lost power in the town reach and was drifting toward the bridge piers.
body: The crew put a tow on and brought the cruiser and its four people into the marina.

title: Child on an inflatable carried out on the ebb
summary: A child on an inflatable ring drifted from the beach toward the Bar.
body: The lifeboat reached the child half a mile offshore. Inflatables and the ebb tide are a bad mix; our advice page explains why.

title: Flood response: residents on Mill Lane
outcome: Eleven people and four dogs moved to the rest center
summary: After two days of rain the Hather came over its banks above the town. The flood rescue team worked with the fire department.
body: The flood rescue boat moved eleven residents and four dogs from Mill Lane to the rest center at the high school. Every crew member on the team holds swiftwater technician training.

title: Search for a missing angler
outcome: Found safe on the far bank
summary: An angler did not come home after night fishing below the weir.
body: Found at 11:20, cold and with a sprained ankle, on the far bank where his phone had no signal.

title: Ice: dog through the ice on the mill pond
outcome: Dog recovered by crew in ice-rescue suits
summary: A dog went through thin ice on the mill pond. Its owner stayed on the bank.
body: Two crew in ice-rescue suits reached the dog with an ice sled.
